title: Croaker, Virginia
lead: Croaker is an unincorporated community in James City County, Virginia, United States on the south bank of the York River 10 miles downstream from West Point. The York River is formed from the confluence of the Mattaponi River and the Pamunkey River at West Point.

title: W. Wangyuh
lead: W. Wangyuh Konyak (born 20 October 1963) was a member of the 14th Lok Sabha of India.

title: Kamarupa inscriptions
lead: The Kamarupa inscriptions are a number of 5th-century to early 13th-century rock, copper plate and clay seal inscriptions associated with the rulers and their subordinates of the Kamarupa region. The common language of these inscriptions is Sanskrit.

title: Klammspitze
lead: The Klammspitze is a double-summit mountain in Bavaria, Germany, north of Linderhof.

title: List of people with anorexia nervosa
lead: This is a list of notable people who had anorexia nervosa. Often simply known as anorexia, this is an eating disorder which is characterized by an obsessive fear of gaining weight, weight loss, and distorted body image.

title: Pelé (2021 film)
lead: Pelé is a 2021 biographical documentary film about Brazilian footballer Pelé. The film was produced and distributed by Netflix and directed by Ben Nichols and David Tryhorn.

title: Citizen Duane
lead: Citizen Duane is a 2006 Canadian comedy film.

title: Larry Keane
lead: Laurence Keane (1931 - 16 July 2017) was an Irish hurler. At club level he played with Thurles Sarsfields and was also a member of the Tipperary senior hurling team.

title: Hans Haug
lead: Hans Haug (27 July 1900 in Basel – 15 September 1967 in Lausanne) was a Swiss composer and conductor, mainly of operas and theatrical music. He also became known as a composer for the classical guitar.

title: List of Sahitya Akademi Award winners for Odia
lead: The Sahitya Akademi Award is given by the Sahitya Akademi, India's national academy of letters, to one writer every year in each of the languages recognized by it, as well as for translations. No awards were given in 1956, 1957, 1959, 1960, 1962 and 1968.

title: Thomas Hinds
lead: Thomas Hinds (January 9, 1780August 23, 1840) was an American soldier and politician from the state of Mississippi, who served in the United States Congress from 1828 to 1831.

title: Smoke Ghost
lead: Smoke Ghost (1998) is the third full-length studio album released on CD by Tadpoles and is the first album with Tadpoles' new drummer, Adam Boyette. Upon original release, Bakery Records included a copy of Tadpoles Destroy Terrastock - Live with all mail-orders.

title: Vokesimurex samui
lead: Vokesimurex samui is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Muricidae, the murex snails or rock snails.

title: Grey column
lead: The grey column refers to a somewhat ridge-shaped mass of grey matter in the spinal cord. This presents as three columns: the anterior grey column, the posterior grey column, and the lateral grey column, all of which are visible in cross-section of the spinal cord.

title: List of first minority male lawyers and judges in North Carolina
lead: This is a list of the first minority male lawyer(s) and judge(s) in North Carolina. It includes the year in which the men were admitted to practice law (in parentheses).

title: Karl Wilhelm Gropius
lead: Karl Wilhelm Gropius, also Carl Wilhelm Gropius (4 April 1793–20 February 1870), was a German set painter and scenic artist, working in the theatres of Berlin. He was also a printmaker and seller  and a prolific caricaturist.
